transcript.text: Hi everyone. As we prepare for the broader rollout of the remote CI-build cache next Monday, I want to do a quick readiness check before I finalize the configuration. Could the cloud infrastructure and CI platform engineering teams share any operational details or concerns I should be aware of? Things like capacity, network considerations, monitoring, or anything else that might affect how we configure the rollout.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While reconciling a different cloud bill this morning, I confirmed that cross-region cache reads would create about $1,200 per month in egress charges, while regional cache reads would stay within the existing build-platform budget. I haven't updated the rollout document yet, but this could be significant for the configuration decision.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: During a compatibility test late yesterday, I confirmed that the cache client cannot safely serve Windows runners. The rollout must exclude Windows projects initially and cover only Linux and macOS projects. I haven't filed the compatibility note yet, but this is critical for the rollout configuration.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text:
Thanks both — this is exactly the kind of operational detail I needed. Let me make sure I have this right before I finalize the configuration:

Mina, so cross-region cache reads would run about $1,200/month in egress, while regional reads stay within the existing build-platform budget. That's a strong argument for configuring the cache in regional mode to avoid the cross-region charges. I'll want to make sure we also set up cost monitoring so we can catch any unexpected egress early.

Theo, so the cache client has a confirmed compatibility issue with Windows runners and we need to exclude Windows projects from the initial rollout, covering only Linux and macOS projects. Got it — I'll configure the rollout scope accordingly.

Two follow-up items I'd like to track:
1. Mina, please update the rollout document with the egress cost findings when you can.
2. Theo, please file the compatibility note about Windows runners so we have it on record.

Unless there are any other concerns, I'm ready to finalize the plan: regional cache mode, Linux and macOS only, Windows excluded, with cost monitoring enabled. Let me know if I'm missing anything else.
transcript.speaker: A1
